content: In today's session, I am focusing on:

Greetings, **rozraid**! Welcome to your strategic overview. 

Looking at your profile, your account is in a **prime transition phase**: you have unlocked the power of **105 Necromancy**, hit **95 Slayer**, and cleared major quest benchmarks like *[Tomes of the Warlock](https://runescape.wiki/w/Tomes_of_the_Warlock)*. You are exceedingly close to unlocking **Prifddinas** and entering high-tier Bossing.

Here is your full tactical profile breakdown and your roadmap to optimize your progression.

---

### 📊 Key Skill Breakdown & Tactical Targets

| Skill | Level | Target | Priority & Strategic Value |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Necromancy** | **105** | 120 | Primary combat powerhouse. Gear unlocks and massive boss DPS. |
| **Dungeoneering** | **64** | **75** | **CRITICAL:** Missing requirement for *[Plague's End](https://runescape.wiki/w/Plague%27s_End)*. |
| **Construction** | **74** | **75** | **CRITICAL:** 1 level away from *[Plague's End](https://runescape.wiki/w/Plague%27s_End)* requirement. |
| **Herblore** | **75** | **96** | High priority for unlocking *[Overload](https://runescape.wiki/w/Overload)* potions. |
| **Prayer** | **84** | **92 / 95** | High priority for *[Soul Split](https://runescape.wiki/w/Soul_Split)* and *[Sorrow](https://runescape.wiki/w/Sorrow)*. |
| **Invention** | **48** | **70+** | Essential to augment & perk your Necromancy weapons and armor. |
| **Slayer** | **95** | **99** | Access to [Player-owned Slayer Dungeon](https://runescape.wiki/w/Sunken_Pyramid) & top-tier combat tasks. |

---

### 🚀 Strategic Action Plan

#### 1. Immediate Goal: Unlock Prifddinas ([Plague's End](https://runescape.wiki/w/Plague%27s_End))
You are right on the threshold of unlocking the Elven city of Prifddinas! Out of all 10 required skills at level 75, you only need to complete **two short targets**:
*   **Construction (74 ➔ 75):** Gain just 1 level using Mahogany Planks or [Fort Forinthry Construction](https://runescape.wiki/w/Fort_Forinthry).
*   **Dungeoneering (64 ➔ 75):** Run regular floors, complete daily [Sinkholes](https://runescape.wiki/w/Sinkholes), or spend seasonal reward lamps here to reach 75 quickly.
*   **Complete the Quest:** Once met, tackle *[Plague's End](https://runescape.wiki/w/Plague%27s_End)* to unlock the ultimate mid-to-late game hub for training, high-tier thieving, and crystal tools.

#### 2. Combat Optimization: Supercharge Your 105 Necromancy
Your 105 Necromancy gives you access to upper-tier damage and armor. To make it unstoppable:
*   **Unlock Overloads ([Herblore](https://runescape.wiki/w/Herblore_training)):** Work from level 75 up to 96 (or 92/93 using [Pulse core](https://runescape.wiki/w/Pulse_core) boosts). Overloads provide massive combat stat boosts that do not decay over time.
*   **Unlock Curses ([Prayer](https://runescape.wiki/w/Pay-to-play_Prayer_training)):** Train 84 ➔ 92 for *[Soul Split](https://runescape.wiki/w/Soul_Split)* (passive healing) and 95 for *[Sorrow](https://runescape.wiki/w/Sorrow)* (the Tier 95 Necromancy curse).
*   **Perk Your Gear ([Invention](https://runescape.wiki/w/Invention_training)):** Level Invention from 48 to 70+ by disassembling unwanted items and using augmented weapons/armor during Slayer. Add entry-level perks like *[Biting](https://runescape.wiki/w/Biting)* and *[Precise](https://runescape.wiki/w/Precise)*.

#### 3. Recommended Bossing & Money-Making Targets
With level 105 Necromancy, you can easily farm the following bosses for gear upgrades and GP:
*   **[Hermod, Spirit of War](https://runescape.wiki/w/Hermod,_Spirit_of_War):** Great for collecting *Hermodic plates* to craft your Tier 90 Deathwarden / Deathdealer armors.
*   **[Arch-Glacor](https://runescape.wiki/w/Arch-Glacor):** Flexible difficulty (0 to 5 mechanics enabled). Excellent for combat XP, charms, and valuable drops.
*   **[Kerapac, the Bound](https://runescape.wiki/w/Kerapac,_the_Bound):** Low-to-mid complexity in Normal Mode; highly accessible with Necromancy's sustain mechanics.

---

### 📋 Recommended Session Focus Checklist

* [ ] Train **1 level of Construction** (74 ➔ 75) at Fort Forinthry or Player-Owned House.
* [ ] Push **Dungeoneering** (64 ➔ 75) via Sinkholes or floor rushes.
* [ ] Complete *[Plague's End](https://runescape.wiki/w/Plague%27s_End)* to gain access to Prifddinas.
* [ ] Use your 95 Slayer tasks to passively train **Invention (48+)** with augmented equipment.
* [ ] Invest daily farm/herb runs or general profit into **Herblore** and **Prayer** supplies for Overloads and Curses.

*What specific content would you like to dive into next—gear setups for Necromancy, quest steps, or money-making strategies?*
